Who I Am

Industrial Automation Architect

I'm Somashekhar S. Anad, Application Engineer at ABB Global — one of the world's leading power and automation technology companies. With 3+ years of hands-on experience, I architect mission-critical IIoT and industrial automation solutions that run at the heart of India's power infrastructure.

My core expertise: ABB Edgenius IoT edge computing, Symphony Plus HMI/DCS, ABB 800xA, and multi-protocol industrial communication (OPC UA, Modbus TCP/RTU, PubSub, Ethernet/IP).

I've engineered and deployed systems across India's largest power plants — NTPC Vindhyachal, Kahalgaon, Singrauli, Farakka, Barh, Simhadri and JSW Steel — collaborating with elite global teams across India and Germany.
